title: Recipes: Set Up and Update Sites From a File | Orchard Core
description:
Setting up a site by hand takes many clicks, and configuring a second site the same way takes them all again.

A recipe is a file that lists the steps to run: enabling features, setting themes, creating roles, defining content types, and adding content. Orchard Core runs a recipe when you choose it on the Setup screen, when you run it from Tools, Recipes, and when you import it.

In this video:
• What a recipe is
• Choosing a recipe on the Setup screen
• Finding recipes on the Recipes page
• Running a recipe and checking the result
• Who can run recipes
